item.tib: dam can yum sras lnga yi dril sgrub
item.coloph: lho ri'i mgul gsang ba'i brag la gter du sbas/ gyer gyer nam pag sku rgyud lo/ /'di g.yung drung bon gyi gter srung yin/ khod spungs zab gter kun la khyab par sbas/ phyi ma'i dus na gter bdag 'di bsgrub cig bon kun dar bar byed/ tshe srog bsring / gran khams thul cing / bstan pa rgyas par byed do/ (?) 'di la shog ser dmar po dkyus la mda' gang zhing 'khyud gang gdag go/
